Separately reviewed FY2025 termination income of 5.157729 trillion and investment-transfer income of 3.717802 trillion materially affect the common-earnings bridge. These observed cash-timing and transaction-income channels support high forward value-estimation uncertainty, even though the FY2025 profit/cash observations and corrected NCI are available.
disconfirmingEvidence: FY2025 reported revenue, group profit and CFO are positive; the final year cash recovery is real evidence against treating the prior negative CFO as a permanent loss.

Investment transfers can recur as part of property development. Fully excluding both named income items is a conservative conditional case, not proven recurring earnings, and a cash-timing gap is not itself an impairment or accounting misstatement.
